Buttons, cards, tables, drawers, filters, search boxes, avatars/PersonTag, confirmation dialogs, status badges - the prototype already has these visually, but they need rewiring to real API calls, loading states, and error states instead of static content files.
Login screens (learner + console, incl. 2-step verification), session-expiry handling, role-aware routing/redirects.
Landing page, module info, FAQ - currently describes the old instant-signup flow and needs its own redesign pass (client explicitly deferred this).
Registration form (incl. province field), and the pending/approved/rejected/resubmit status screen wired to a real application record instead of a prototype preview switcher.
Dashboard, module browsing/enrolment, module filter/search UI.
Content blocks (video player, text, materials list), lecture navigation.

Browse/search/filter Law and Tool entries, province-first ordering for Laws.
